select vo.ORDER_ID as orderId, d.TRADE_ID as tradeId, cp.FINPROD_ID as prodId, cp.FINPROD_ABBR as prodAbbr, zc.FINPROD_ID as assetId, zc.FINPROD_ABBR as assetAbbr, d.finprod_type as finprodTypeCode, d.finprod_type as finprodType, vo.PS as psCode, vo.PS as ps, DATE_FORMAT(vo.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as settleDate, vo.MY_ACCT_NO as myAcctNo, vo.COUNTER_ACCT_NO as counterAcctNo, voi1.ACCT_NAME as myAcctName, voi2.ACCT_NAME as counterAcctName, vo.CCY as ccyCode, vo.CCY as ccy, vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderTypeCode, vo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType, d.IS_CLEAN as isClean, IFNULL(tdf.FEE_AMT,'0') as tdFeeAmt, vo.SETTLE_AMT as settleAmt, vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatusCode, vo.SETTLE_STATUS as settleStatus from trd_PRODUCT_DEAL d left join FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = d.finprod_id
left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD e on d.trade_id = e.trade_id
left join FIN_PRODUCT cp on cp.finprod_id = '不进行关�?'
inner join stl_ORDERS vo on vo.trade_id = d.trade_id
inner join Stl_Orders_Ext stl_ext on vo.order_id=stl_ext.order_id and stl_ext.is_trade='N' left join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL tdf on tdf.trade_id = d.trade_id and tdf.fee_type = 'B09' left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO voi1 on voi1.acct_no = vo.my_acct_no left join STL_CAPACCT_INFO voi2 on voi2.acct_no = vo.counter_acct_no where vo.order_id = #{orderId}
